task.description:
REWORK 2:
- [MAJOR] TC-ADP-04a-06 still lacks a dedicated automated case. The rerun confirms the integration suite passes, but the current test source does not contain a specific case proving NULL-linkage coexistence plus duplicate non-NULL realm/sub rejection and index/backfill proof.

Change approach: add or extend automated test code under tests/integration so TC-ADP-04a-06 is implemented as a concrete test case, not only documented in the spec. Cover all of these in code: 1) multiple internal users with NULL external linkage coexist without conflict; 2) duplicate non-NULL (external_realm, external_id) rejection; 3) unique index shape or metadata proof if needed; and 4) any legacy migration/backfill fixture required to prove compatibility. Keep scope limited to test source and spec artifacts; do not touch implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: TC-ADP-04a-06 is implemented as a concrete automated test case
The test source covers duplicate non-NULL rejection and multiple NULL coexistence
Any migration/backfill fixture needed to prove compatibility is included

result.summary: Implemented TC-ADP-04a-06 as a concrete integration test with NULL-linkage coexistence, duplicate external identity rejection, and unique index metadata proof.
